title: Maximum Subarray Sum
prompt: Given an array of integers (space-separated on one line of stdin), find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and print the sum.
starter_code:
import sys

def max_subarray(nums):
    # TODO: implement
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    nums = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    print(max_subarray(nums))
solution:
import sys
nums = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
best = cur = nums[0]
for n in nums[1:]:
    cur = max(n, cur + n)
    best = max(best, cur)
print(best)
